lines.x: The naira closed weaker at N1,350.45 per dollar on 5 November 2026, down from N1,346.01 previously, while interbank turnover dropped to about $82 million according to Central Bank of Nigeria data.
Fintech company OPay Ltd. has suspended its planned $300 million initial public offering in the United States.
The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) absorbed N3.46 trillion through Open Market Operations and Treasury Bill auctions held on November 3 and 4.

Banking system liquidity in Nigeria remained high as banks parked N8.31 trillion at the Central Bank of Nigeria's Standing Deposit Facility, even after the regulator mopped up N724 billion via OMO auctions.
